body.zh: 液体吸热升温、离火后向环境散热（温度越高降得越快）。本实验台在 60 °C 给出过热提示、95 °C 触发安全锁定——锁定后只能查看原因并从检查点重来，这是虚拟实验特有的“保险丝”。
body.en: Liquids warm as they absorb heat and cool toward room temperature off the heat (faster when hotter). This lab warns at 60 °C and safety-locks at 95 °C — after a lock you inspect the reason and restart from a checkpoint, a fuse only a virtual lab can offer.
